findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation before permitting document reads
findings.body: When a user's tenant differs from the document's tenant, `canReadDocument` now still returns `true`. This removes the prior tenant-isolation boundary and permits cross-tenant reads wherever this guard is used. Retain the equality check or apply equivalent authorization logic.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation in the document read check
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now authorizes every request. Any user whose `userTenant` differs from `documentTenant` will pass the check, enabling cross-tenant document access wherever this function gates reads.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation before permitting document reads
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now authorizes every request. Any caller supplying a `userTenant` different from `documentTenant` receives `true`, bypassing tenant isolation and enabling cross-tenant document access.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
